name: Qin Shi Huang (Sports Emperor)
source:
An alter ego of Qin Shi Huang, created by Seimei's secret arts to grant her wish to "participate in a festival where I can move my body with all my might."

It is a part of her soul that has been split off and materialized, and it is said to feel squishy when you touch it.
